Show event/commit identifiers and the exact recommended coordinator action. Provide fixtures for normal short latency, permanently stranded close, shared-worktree foreign commit, clock-free deterministic grace handling, and successful automatic successor pull. The feature may land as part of the accepted SF8 overview item or a follow-up, but must share its single-pass fold and remain fast.
body.forbid: no automatic close, lease release, successor pull, process kill, Git mutation or scientific promotion; no uncommitted file called a result; no OS process or window title treated as agent identity or lifecycle evidence; no raw git-log subject used as a certificate verdict; no wall-clock fallback; no warning before an explicitly configured deterministic grace interval; no second full programme parse that erases the dashboard fast path
notes: The two live examples resolved correctly within minutes; the requested value is recognizing when the same intermediate state does not resolve.
A runtime or Git overlay is operational evidence only. WORK_REPORTED plus terminal transitions remain authoritative.
